title: Liminal Textures
description: Retextures of blocks to help make liminal spaces
body:
# Retextured Blocks To Make A Liminal Space
## WARNING: These textures will MOST DEFINITELY affect how your builds look.
A simple and small texture pack that aims to help making liminal spaces easier.

**Current Textures Changes:**
1. Black concrete -> Pure black
2. Glowstone -> Pure white
3. Copper bulb -> Lamps
4. Polished andesite -> Ceiling tiles
5. Yellow wool & carpet-> Carpet
6. Yellow concrete -> Wallpaper
7. Yellow terracotta -> Wallpaper (with skirting)
8. Backyard painting -> Backrooms entrance based on movie

**White and black rooms**

Making an infinite space of darkness is very simple since the texture pack changes the black concrete textures to pure black. So building a box around should be enough.

![Player in white room vs player in black room](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d81ba193346e9c0f29c5e73d9636e73d382cebd_0.webp)
However, making a white room is completely different.

You would still need to use item frames and completely white maps to make the walls (since minecraft's code adds shadows to block faces) but the floor is bright enough to match with the maps.

Basically allows the player to place blocks on top of it without making it obvious that an item frame is on the floor.

**_It is recommened to use invisible item frames to remove the thickness of the map when placed down._**

**Backrooms**

The backrooms are pretty easy to make. You just use yellow wool/carpet to make the floor, yellow concrete and terracotta to make the walls, and polished andesite and copper bulbs for the ceiling.

![The backrooms (preview)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80f9faa3a1fd7602095a31fff5194eb3f4e945be_0.webp)
When making the lamps, the texture pack only works on normal copper bulb textures.

So if the copper bulb oxidises it would not be affected by the texture pack and still look like a copper bulb.

The easiest fix to this is to wax the copper bulb when it is still normal.

![Backyard painting retexture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a98be7f4b0502f97a8c78d326233384e46c55de.png)

**_These textures are not my original textures but are textures borrowed from the internet._**

**_This is just a texture pack that puts all liminal textures in one after all_**
